episode_title: Power Players: Can AI really regulate itself?

real_qa.q: What are the four points of the White House AI self-regulation accord announced after Trump's lunch with tech CEOs?
real_qa.r: The four points include internal controls within organizations, staff empowered to oversee implementation, external auditors to review the process, and an independent committee of the board of directors to oversee and receive reports from teams operating the controls and internal and external auditors and evaluators, ensuring any identified issues are remediated. However, this accord is morally binding rather than legally binding.
real_qa.requete: White House AI accord four points

real_qa.q: What did Jacob Coxon say about AI existential risk while working at Anthropic?
real_qa.r: Jacob Coxon, who quit Anthropic and previously worked at OpenAI, stated that people deep in the weeds coding AI believe there is a greater than 10 percent chance of human extinction if the current rate of progress continues, and that many foundational researchers believe there is a real possibility of human extinction from AI.
real_qa.requete: Jacob Coxon AI extinction risk percentage

real_qa.q: Why does Jensen Huang of NVIDIA reject claims about AI existential risk?
real_qa.r: Jensen Huang stated that the 10 percent existential risk claim is not grounded in science or research, and that just because it comes from a scientist does not make it scientific. He argues that scaring young people about AI threatening their jobs is unhelpful rather than socially good.
real_qa.requete: Jensen Huang AI existential risk not scientific

real_qa.q: What is the University of Massachusetts poll finding on American public support for AI data centres?
real_qa.r: According to a University of Massachusetts poll, only 11% of Americans support data centres, which form the bedrock of AI infrastructure development.
real_qa.requete: University of Massachusetts poll AI data centres support 11%

real_qa.q: What did China's President Xi say about global AI cooperation at a recent summit?
real_qa.r: President Xi stated that AI development should not be a solo performance by any one country but rather a symphony of global cooperation, emphasizing the need to strengthen safety guardrails, prevent abuse and malicious use, and ensure AI remains under human control.
real_qa.requete: Xi Jinping AI global cooperation symphony

real_qa.q: What is Andrew Bailey's position as Governor of the Bank of England on AI regulation timing?
real_qa.r: Andrew Bailey stated that regulating AI is not the right place to start, and that rigorous testing should come first while the pace of progress must accelerate.
real_qa.requete: Andrew Bailey Bank of England AI regulation
